name: Doomity (DOOM + UNITY)
author: NathanFuentes
description:
Play Doom on WebGL
If JS error, then play.unity.com is blocking music player, play it directly on:
https://kncarnage.itch.io/doomity

It's loading the shareware wad from:

https://doomwiki.org/wiki/DOOM1.WAD

You can paste the URL of another IWAD to use, then "Get IWAD"

It can download HD Assets

Everything is stored on db storage

Tilde or Backslash (Under ESC Key) for Menu

WASD for Moving

More Info:

https://www.doomworld.com/forum/topic/120309-doomity-public-beta-released/
